Simple purées

Apple and chestnut purée

Almás gesztenyepüré

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

Keep it completely smooth. Start with a small portion on a well day.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 80 g cooked peeled chestnuts (plain, with no sugar and no salt, not a sweetened spread)
  • 200 g apple (prepared weight, peeled, cored, and cooked until soft)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Use plain cooked chestnuts that are fully peeled, or boil peeled chestnuts until soft.
  2. Cook the peeled, cored apple until soft.
  3. Blend chestnut and apple together until there are no pieces left.
  4. Add a spoon of cooking water only if the blade stalls.
  5. Do not add sugar.

Adjusted

Chestnut pieces can choke if the purée is not fully smooth. Chestnut allergy exists, and chestnut is not the same food as peanut or walnut.

Blend cooked peeled chestnut with cooked apple until completely smooth, and give a small first portion on a day when the baby is well. Do not count this as the tree-nut introduction, and do not use a sweetened chestnut spread.
